latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Clip skill.
- Instantly trim, cut, or extract precise segments from any video by time range using ffmpeg (no API key needed).
- Local, stream-copy clipping for near-instant results.
- Automatically escalate to AI Edit tool when intelligent highlight extraction or smart editing is requested (requires SPARKI_API_KEY).
- Includes error reference and usage examples for both clipping and AI-powered editing.
